## Custom licenses

- **Sodium** uses the [PolyForm Shield 1.0.0](https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/blob/dev/LICENSE.md). It is not a general open-source grant: the pack links to the official download and never mirrors or modifies it.
- **Entity Culling** uses the [tr7zw Protective License](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/blob/1.18/LICENSE-EntityCulling). It is not a general open-source grant: the pack links to the official download and never mirrors or modifies it.

LGPL and MPL projects (Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, Chat Heads, Continuity, AmbientSounds, CreativeCore, Text Placeholder API, Cloth Config API) are used unmodified; their source is linked above.
